dedupe_keys.name: guinea localities covered by 2g and 3g telecommunication networks american red cross 2017

description: This dataset lists the names of localities in Guinea that were covered by the 2G and 3G mobile telecommunication networks in 2017. It was compiled by the American Red Cross, which used such lists in its West African health and disaster preparedness work after the Ebola epidemic, and published on the Humanitarian Data Exchange as a single Excel workbook of about 420 KB. Each row names a locality with its administrative units and the network coverage available there; the notes state that the file does not contain geographic coordinates, so localities must be matched to a gazetteer or settlement layer to be mapped. The publishing organisation is now marked inactive on the exchange, so the file will not be updated. Coverage: Guinea, by locality, as of 2017. Format and access: XLS download from the Humanitarian Data Exchange, free; the licence is given only as 'Other'. Caveats: a single snapshot; operator source and method are not described; locality names vary in spelling; no coordinates. Simulation uses: a baseline of which settlements had mobile service, for Guinean emergency communication, cash transfer and early warning reach studies. Related records: the Emergency Telecommunications Cluster Ebola operation layers cover Guinea in 2014; the OpenCelliD database gives crowdsourced cell locations; the ITU ICT statistics give national series.
